title.narrative: Domestic Credit Ratings for Japan-Africa SME Partnerships

description.narrative: As access to affordable finance remains a key constraint to Africa’s economic transformation, SMEs in Ghana and Côte d’Ivoire face limited investment due to weak risk perception, fragmented financial data, and insufficient links to external investors. This UNDP initiative addresses these barriers by strengthening domestic credit rating ecosystems and deploying digital tools to improve SME transparency, data availability, and investment readiness. By combining robust SME credit assessment methodologies with a digital risk-assessment and investment-matching platform, the project aims to narrow the gap between actual and perceived risk, catalyze Japan–Africa SME partnerships, and expand access to sustainable financing in support of the Sustainable Development Goals.
